purpose: silver_airport_weather holds hourly weather observations for three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) from January through June 2013, with each row capturing one airport's atmospheric conditions at one UTC hour alongside static airport reference attributes.
usage: Read the table at the grain of one row per (airport_code, observed_hour_utc); join observed_date_local and observed_hour_local for local-time reporting. Consumers must handle nulls in wind_dir_degrees, wind_speed_mph, wind_gust_mph (the sparsest field at 74.6% null), and pressure_mb (11.5% null), and should expect airport_name, airport_municipality, airport_elevation_ft, and airport_longest_runway_ft to repeat identically across all rows sharing an airport_code.
limitations: The profile shows row-count arithmetic consistent with an (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) grain (13014 rows versus an expected 13023 from 3 airports times 4341 hours) and a 0.0 duplicate_row_rate on whole rows, but a deterministic grain measurement has not yet confirmed no duplicate key pairs. wind_gust_mph, pressure_mb, wind_dir_degrees, and wind_speed_mph carry nontrivial null rates limiting their completeness. captured_at has only 3 distinct values clustered within seconds, suggesting a pipeline load timestamp rather than domain data; reviewers should confirm whether it belongs in the contract despite is_airbyte_metadata reading false for every column in this profile.
